source.heading: INT. ANAADHI’S PRIMARY CABIN – BEFORE DAWN
source.start: Seventeen lamps burn beneath seventeen names. Aarathi returns alone.
source.end: Aarathi takes the portable seventeen-name display. Anaadhi remains before the lamps as the first hidden drones enter the forest.

locks.env6: NO_SB; EP0 physical surrender-terms only; inner-voice discussion is testimony, never a staged encounter
locks.anaadhi: CHR-ANAADHI; age27; 193cm; forest-pre-capture; imposing but exhausted; no capture hair/ADK-7
locks.aarathi: CHR-AARATHI; returns alone; look controlled-unresolved; do not invent visible weapon
locks.memorial: exactly 17 lamps beneath exactly 17 wooden names; fixed 9+8 lamp continuity
locks.display: same RUKEY_seventeen_name_display from SC060-SC062; start beside wood list; Aarathi takes at end
locks.weapons: all Anaadhi weapons locked beneath PRP-SPLIT-FLOORBOARD and never visible; key on table; no opening/handling

resolution.base_prompt: ANAADHI SC063 exact approved screenplay; real before-dawn ENV-CAB-008/WC059; restrained realism; exactly 17 lamps/17 wooden names; weapons unseen below locked floor; key design and unsourced technology details not invented; 3840x1600 2.40:1.

shots: Establish unchanged WC059 cabin before dawn with seventeen lamps beneath seventeen names
Confirm exactly seventeen lamp flames and seventeen name positions
Aarathi has returned alone; do not invent entry mechanism
Reveal locked floorboard and key already on table; weapons remain unseen
Aarathi asks if that is every weapon
Anaadhi answers every weapon he prepared; hands not included
ANAADHI: Every weapon I prepared. My hands are not included.
Aarathi states his hands remain his responsibility
AARATHI: Then your hands remain your responsibility.
Anaadhi looks across the seventeen names before conditions
Condition: dawn, main door, no one enters first
ANAADHI: Dawn. I walk through the main door. No one enters first.
Main door remains closed/controlled in present
Condition: police only; no Sarjanya; no private men
ANAADHI: Police only. No Sarjanya. No private men.
Condition: no Paraane doctor unless emergency
ANAADHI: No Paraane doctor near me unless there is an emergency.
Condition: every medicine named and explained
ANAADHI: Every medicine must be named and explained.
Condition: no injection without consent unless immediate threat to life
ANAADHI: No injection without consent unless I am an immediate threat to life.
Condition: Aarathi remains where he can see her
ANAADHI: You remain where I can see you.
Aarathi can request all; police command must accept
AARATHI: I can request all of that. Police command must accept it.
Anaadhi says if not accepted he does not open door
ANAADHI: If they do not accept it, I do not open the door.
Aarathi states warrant remains; they may still enter
AARATHI: The warrant will remain. They may still enter.
ANAADHI: Then it will be capture, not surrender.
Aarathi asks whether anyone ordered the seventeen murders
AARATHI: Before I send the location: did anyone order the seventeen murders?
Aarathi asks whether any voice removed his ability to choose every time
AARATHI: Did any voice remove your ability to choose every time?
Anaadhi says it made the choice feel impossible
ANAADHI: It made the choice feel impossible.
Hold unchanged real room; no subjective staging
Aarathi asks if it was impossible
Anaadhi says no and cites walking away first
ANAADHI: No. I proved that by walking away first.
Aarathi says returning proved the decision was his
AARATHI: And by returning, you proved the decision was yours.
Send consented cabin location and surrender conditions to Unnath
Integrated Paraane authorisation system auto-copies Anarvaa and central medical command
Aarathi states location sent and Paraane auto-copy
AARATHI: Location sent. The system copied Paraane automatically.
Anaadhi asks how many doors are connected behind the one opened
ANAADHI: You opened one door. How many are connected behind it?
Aarathi says too many and she is going to command hall
AARATHI: Too many. I am going to the command hall now.
Anaadhi asks her to return with names, not file
ANAADHI: Come back with the names, not the file.
Aarathi reaches for same portable seventeen-name display
Display lifts away from wooden list; wooden seventeen names remain fixed
Aarathi takes the portable seventeen-name display
Memorial count hold after display removal
Exterior forest before dawn; weather unstated
First hidden drones enter forest, distant and partially occluded
Restrained closer reveal of hidden drone silhouette between trees
Exact SC063 end: Anaadhi remains before lamps as first hidden drones enter forest
